notApplicable.size: Dialog has no public size variants; its viewport-constrained surface uses overlay roles.
notApplicable.density: Modal surface geometry does not use collection density.
notApplicable.disabled: The modal itself is not a disabled action; disabled sibling actions are exercised by pending-confirm/pending-cancel.
notApplicable.selected: A modal does not select data.
notApplicable.loading: The modal surface has no independent loading prop; its real pending-confirm/pending-cancel actions retain natural animation frames and video.
